title: Genomic and immune profiling characterizes immune heterogeneity and a TIGIT-associated subtype in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
snippet: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) is characterized by marked molecular and microenvironmental heterogeneity and moderate response to immunotherapy. We aimed to define the genomic and spatial determinants of immune checkpoint activity in iCCA and their association with clinical outcome.
